blocks.prompt: 8. When the polynomial \(x^{3} + x^{2} + x + k\) is divided by \(x - 1\), the remainder [printed as 'reminder'] is 7. Find the value of \(k\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bilkul Sawal 7 jaisa hai: ek coefficient \(k\) maloom nahi aur remainder diya gaya hai, 7.
Remainder theorem: \(x - 1\) se divide karne par remainder \(f(1)\) hota hai.
Plan: \(f(1)\) nikalna, us ko 7 ke barabar rakhna, aur \(k\) hal karna. Kitab mein "reminder" chhapa hai; matlab "remainder" (baqi) hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^{3} + x^{2} + x + k\), divisor \(x - 1\), remainder 7.
Humein find karna hai: \(k\).
Tareeqa: Remainder theorem: \(x - a\) se divide karne par remainder \(f(a)\). Division karne ki zaroorat nahi; sirf \(x\) ki jagah \(a\) rakhna hai.

\(a\) pehchanein
\[x - 1 = x - a\]
\[a = 1\]
Kyun: Divisor pehle se \(x - a\) ki shakal mein hai, minus ke saath, is liye \(a = 1\) seedha mil gaya. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: \(x - 1 = 0\) se \(x = 1\).

\(f(1)\) nikalein
\[f(1) = (1)^{3} + (1)^{2} + (1) + k\]
\[= 1 + 1 + 1 + k\]
\[= k + 3\]
Kyun: 1 ki har power 1 hi hoti hai, is liye pehli teen terms 1, 1, 1 ban gayin aur un ka jama 3 hua. \(k\) maloom nahi, is liye usay waise hi likha.

Diye gaye remainder se equation banayein
\[k + 3 = 7\]
\[k = 4\]
Kyun: Remainder \(f(1)\) hai aur sawal ke mutabiq remainder 7 hai; dono barabar rakhe. 3 doosri taraf gaya to \(k = 7 - 3 = 4\).

Tasdeeq
\[f(1) = 1 + 1 + 1 + 4\]
\[= 7 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(k = 4\) rakh kar remainder dobara nikala to 7 aaya, jo sawal mein diya gaya hai. Agar kitab ki key wala \(k = 8\) rakhein to \(1 + 1 + 1 + 8 = 11\) aata hai, 7 nahi; is liye key ka jawab ghalat hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "the reminder is 7" chhapa hai; durust lafz "remainder" (baqi) hai. Answer key mein \(k = 8\) chhapa hai, jo ghalat hai: \(k = 8\) rakhein to \(f(1) = 3 + 8 = 11\) aata hai, 7 nahi. Sahi jawab \(k = 4\) hai.
